sloka: स ताः प्रोवाच राजा तु रावणो घोर दर्शनाः ।प्रचाल्य चरण उत्कर्षैः दारयन् इव मेदिनीम् ॥३-५६-२९॥
transliteration: sa tāḥ provāca rājā tu rāvaṇo ghora darśanāḥ ।pracālya caraṇa utkarṣaiḥ dārayan iva medinīm ॥3-56-29॥

translations.english: Stamping his feet and shaking the ground as if tearing the earth, Ravana said to those fiercelooking demonesses:
